retrospective_proxy_score.role_score_comparison_forbidden: Each role uses different dimensions. Role scores are maturity summaries, not a cross-role model ranking.
retrospective_proxy_score.selection_barrier: The wrong-CLEAN gate is indeterminate and reproducibility is partial, so the score cannot select a stack.

important_missing_metrics.collection_plan: Run a frozen mutation set on each prospective test suite.
Use novel analogues of historical defect classes with a withheld evaluator.
Adjudicate every prospective finding as true, false, duplicate, or unverifiable.
Seed a known defect corpus and preserve the hidden answer key.
Adjudicate primary and contributing owners under the benchmark attribution contract.
Require paired synthetic and real-shape fixtures and score disagreement.
Run at least three independent repeats per screening cell and five for finalists.
Time operator adjudication, prompt repair, and manual cleanup separately.
Require confidence on plans, implementations, and findings; score against adjudicated outcomes.
Run static metrics plus blinded human maintainability review.
Audit a fixed percentage of CLEAN units after merge and reopen wrong CLEAN records.
Record every timeout, error, length stop, content filter, retry, and unrecovered tool failure per run.

prospective_model_pool_validation.validation: Official sources position GPT-5.3-Codex as an agentic coding model, MAI-Code-1.1-Flash as a small-tier coding model, Sonnet 5 for strong everyday/CLI agentic coding, Terra as a balanced agentic-coding default, Sol for high-ceiling large-codebase reasoning, Luna for smaller cost-efficient tasks, and Gemini 3.7 Flash for complex coding, agents, reliable multi-step execution, tunable high reasoning, codebase research, and verification.

baseline_conclusion: The incumbent stack has strong eventual quality on audited tasks but substantial repair burden and incomplete first-pass realism. Historical evidence is sufficient to define probes and a baseline, not to rank model families. The prospective comparison is multi-model and role-matched; no winner is selected.
